article.title: CIA Director John Brennan pressed Ukraine government to use force in Donbass in April 2014
article.author: Jeremy Kuzmarov
article.content: CIA Director John Brennan was key to U.S. foreign policy strategy that aimed to draw Russia into quagmire in Ukraine and attack its energy infrastructure so U.S. oil and gas producers could take over its depleted markets. The post CIA Director John Brennan pressed Ukraine government to use force in Donbass in April 2014 appeared first on MR Online .
